# Scalar contexts beside a generic array and independent object

An independently owned static provider receives a method-owned array, an unrelated
Object and original scalar contexts. Frozen direct, separately compiled caller,
reflection and MethodHandle paths observe array identity, mutations and runtime
component checks, opaque integer results, exact callback failures and deferred
unboxing. Wide calls preserve long extremes, NaN payloads, negative zero and flags.
Both source and SDK profiles compile every emitted source and compare definitions,
roles, Signature and Exceptions. Fifteen wrong programs qualify 192 fresh cases,
each repeated twice; eight same-Code Signature controls check rejection.
